# Sources of the Hadamard expansion

The files under `OAI/` come from OpenAI's public mathematics repository at commit `4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae`. The two imported modules prove growth bounds and a Hadamard logarithmic-derivative formula for primitive, nonprincipal Dirichlet characters. The repository license is included in this directory. [ConductorCompletedL](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae/lean/OAI/NumberTheory/SiegelZeros/Characters/ConductorCompletedL.lean) · [MellinConvergentTopIndicator](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae/lean/OAI/NumberTheory/SiegelZeros/EntireFunctions/MellinConvergentTopIndicator.lean) · [License](LICENSE.openai-math)

The files under `PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/SiegelZeros/` are the new files from that same commit's Lean 4.34.1 compatibility patch for PrimeNumberTheoremAnd. The Git blob of the patch is `924c5f6ec6fe88ba7788b420af4e3c3c7ac00abc`. The patch targets PrimeNumberTheoremAnd commit `c39a751132c88b6e8080b74c74023fd95b3d8be0`. The retained notices credit Matteo Cipollina and Stefan Kebekus. [Patch](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae/lean/patches/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd-lean4341.patch) · [Original source repository](https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/tree/c39a751132c88b6e8080b74c74023fd95b3d8be0) · [Notices](PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/SiegelZeros/NOTICE.md)
